templates.name: review
templates.command: reasonix run --permission-mode acceptEdits 'Review the following changes and provide feedback: $@'

templates.name: commit-zen
templates.command: reasonix run --permission-mode acceptEdits 'Review git status and diff, then generate a concise git commit message with commitizen convention and logical grouping. Output the commit message text only - do not stage, commit, or push changes: $@'

templates.name: commit-staged
templates.command: reasonix run --permission-mode auto 'Run git diff --staged then do atomic commit message for the change with commitizen convention. Write clear, informative commit messages that explain the what and why behind changes, not just the how.'
templates.description: Atomic commit message with staged changes

templates.name: commit-atomic
templates.command: reasonix run --permission-mode auto 'Run git status and git diff to review all changes. Group changes into logical, independent units. Stage each group intentionally using git add with specific files or git add -p -- never use git add -A or git add --all. Commit each group with a commitizen conventional commits message (type(scope): subject) that explains the what and why. Verify staged changes with git diff --staged before each commit.'
templates.description: Atomic commit messages with logical grouping and commitizen convention

templates.name: architecture-explanation
templates.command: reasonix run --permission-mode acceptEdits 'Explain this codebase architecture'

templates.name: draft-pull-request
templates.command: reasonix run --permission-mode auto 'Create a draft pull request using gh CLI. First review the git log and diff since the base branch. Then compose a structured PR description with three sections: What (what was changed), Why (the motivation and problem solved), How (the technical approach and key decisions). Run: gh pr create --draft --title "[concise imperative title]" --body "[what/why/how description]"'
templates.description: Create draft pull request with what/why/how template via gh CLI

templates.name: types
templates.command: reasonix run --permission-mode acceptEdits 'Improve TypeScript types: Remove any, add proper type guards, ensure strict mode compliance for: $@'

templates.name: test
templates.command: reasonix run --permission-mode acceptEdits 'Write tests using Arrange-Act-Assert pattern. Focus on behavior, not implementation details for: $@'

templates.name: docs
templates.command: reasonix run --permission-mode acceptEdits 'Add JSDoc comments with @param and @returns. Include usage examples for: $@'

templates.name: explain
templates.command: reasonix run --permission-mode acceptEdits 'Explain this code in detail: 1) What it does 2) How it works 3) Design decisions: $@'

templates.name: review-security
templates.command: reasonix run --permission-mode acceptEdits 'Security review: Check for injection vulnerabilities, input validation, auth issues, and sensitive data handling in: $@'

templates.name: review-refactor
templates.command: reasonix run --permission-mode acceptEdits 'Refactor suggestion: Improve readability, eliminate complexity, and apply clean code principles to: $@'

templates.name: review-performance
templates.command: reasonix run --permission-mode acceptEdits 'Analyze performance: Identify bottlenecks, suggest optimizations with measurable impact for: $@'

templates.name: remove-verbal
templates.command: reasonix run --permission-mode acceptEdits 'Analyze code: Identify verbal comment and remove it, and ensure consistency in style for: $@'
templates.description: Clean verbal comments that explain 'what' the code is doing rather than 'why'

templates.name: remove-ai-slop
templates.command: reasonix run --permission-mode acceptEdits "You're reviewing code cleanup. Remove: 1) Excessive comments that break existing documentation style 2) Defensive checks that don't match the codebase's trust model 3) Type escape hatches (any casts, assertions) 4) Generic patterns that feel imported rather than native. Match the file's existing voice and conventions. Report what you removed in 1-3 sentences: $@"

templates.name: tidy-first
templates.command: reasonix run --permission-mode acceptEdits 'Apply Tidy First principles: 1) Use guard clauses 2) Extract helper variables for complex expressions 3) Remove dead code 4) Normalize symmetries. Focus on making the code easier to understand: $@'

templates.name: simplify
templates.command: reasonix run --permission-mode acceptEdits "Simplify this code: Remove unnecessary complexity, eliminate over-engineering, reduce coupling. Keep solutions simple and focused on what's actually needed: $@"

templates.name: simplifier
templates.command: reasonix run --permission-mode acceptEdits 'Simplify and refine code for clarity, consistency, and maintainability while preserving all functionality. Focus on recently modified code unless instructed otherwise: $@'
templates.description: Simplifies and refines code for clarity, consistency, and maintainability while preserving all functionality. Focuses on recently modified code unless instructed otherwise.

templates.name: logical-grouping-pull-request
templates.command: reasonix run --permission-mode auto 'Analyze the git changes and create a draft PR, plan: 1) Group changes into logical, independent commits 2) Order them by dependency (low-level to high-level) 3) Run git commit for each change group 4) Write PR description with what why how.'
templates.description: Create a draft pull request for the git changes with logical grouping

templates.name: summary
templates.command: ai summary --provider opencode2 --mode tldr $@
